scripts.build: tsc --noEmit || true && vite build && find dist -name '*.meta' -delete && node scripts/finalize-singlefile.mjs
scripts.postbuild: echo 'Cleaning metadata and compressing...' && find dist -type f -regextype posix-extended -regex '.*\.(html|js|css|json|svg)$' -exec brotli -f -k -9 {} + && echo 'Build complete: Metadata cleaned & Brotli compression performed.'
